mapper.select: SELECT r.read_id, r.send_record_id, r.user_id, r.user_type, r.is_read, r.read_time, r.reply_status, r.reply_time, r.send_status, r.create_time FROM notification_user_read_record r INNER JOIN notification_send_record s ON s.send_record_id = r.send_record_id WHERE s.notification_id = #{notificationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.send_status = '1' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_user_read_record SET is_read = '1', read_time = NOW() WHERE read_id = #{readId} AND is_read = '0'
UPDATE notification_user_read_record SET reply_status = '1', reply_time = NOW() WHERE read_id = #{readId} AND reply_status = '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_user_read_record r INNER JOIN notification_send_record s ON s.send_record_id = r.send_record_id INNER JOIN notification n ON n.notification_id = s.notification_id AND n.status = '1' WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.send_status = '1'
AND r.student_user_id = #{studentUserId}
